stem_book: A car moves at constant speed on the road as shown in figure. The normal force by the road on the car is N_A and N_B when it is at the points A and B respectively. (a) N_A = N_B (b) N_A > N_B (c) N_A < N_B (d) insufficient information to decide the relation of N_A and N_B
key: C N A < N B You marked: D
work: on a crest N = mg − mv²/r; A has the smaller radius of curvature ⇒ N_A < N_B
